PSAL. CXIX. VER. 129.
Thy Testimonies are wonderful; therefore doth my Soul keep them.
IN the Words are two Parts,

I. The dignity and excellency of Gods testimonies, Thy testimonies are wonderful.
II. The effect it had upon David's heart, Therefore doth my soul keep them.

Doctr. 1. That the testimonies of God, when duly considered, and throughly understood, will indeed be found to be wonderful.
Doctr. 2. The wonderful excellency of the word should beget in our hearts a readiness and diligent care to keep it.
